mentions.name: Menu Engineering
mentions.description: This app lets restaurant managers build and analyze menus as a tree structure, replacing Excel-based menu management since tabular spreadsheets do not fit a menu's hierarchy.
mentions.problem: Tabular data in an Excel doc does not play well with a menu's tree structure.
mentions.audience: A friend who manages their restaurant's menu.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Menu Engineering (https://github.com/TravisBumgarner/menu-engineering)
I have a friend who manages their restaurant's menu via an Excel doc. Tabular data does not play well with a menu's tree structure. So I'm building them an app to more easily build and analyze the menu.
